note: Candidate interview questions written from themes in 2026 AI interview guides. Admins add them to Interview prep from Admin functions.

questions.q: How would you build a RAG system for a company's internal documents, end to end?
questions.followup: Which part of that pipeline is most likely to fail first, and how would you notice?

questions.q: How do you evaluate a RAG pipeline? Which metrics would you track?
questions.followup: Why measure retrieval quality and answer quality separately?

questions.q: A RAG chatbot gives a wrong answer. How do you tell whether the retriever or the model is at fault?
questions.followup: Why is this diagnosis the first step before changing anything?

questions.q: When would you choose RAG, and when fine-tuning?
questions.followup: Why is fine-tuning a poor way to add facts that change often?

questions.q: How do you choose an embedding model and a vector database?
questions.followup: Why might a smaller embedding model be the better choice?

questions.q: What is hybrid search, and when does it beat pure vector search?
questions.followup: Why do exact keywords still matter for things like product codes and names?

questions.q: How would you handle documents that contain tables, images and scanned pages?
questions.followup: Why does document parsing quality limit the whole RAG system?

questions.q: How do you keep a RAG index fresh when source documents change daily?
questions.followup: Why is deleting outdated chunks as important as adding new ones?

questions.q: How would you enforce document permissions so users only retrieve what they are allowed to see?
questions.followup: Why must access control happen at retrieval time, not only in the prompt?

questions.q: Explain how a transformer works to someone non-technical, then to an engineer.
questions.followup: Why is the ability to explain at two levels valuable on a team?

questions.q: What is the KV cache, and why does it matter for inference speed and memory?
questions.followup: Why does a long context window increase serving cost?

questions.q: What do temperature and top-p do, and how would you set them for a coding assistant?
questions.followup: Why would you use different settings for creative writing?

questions.q: What causes hallucinations, and what techniques reduce them?
questions.followup: Why can no technique remove hallucinations completely?

questions.q: Compare encoder-only, decoder-only and encoder-decoder models, with an example of each.
questions.followup: Why did decoder-only models come to dominate generative AI?

questions.q: What is positional encoding, and why do many models use RoPE?
questions.followup: Why does position information matter for long contexts?

questions.q: How does tokenization affect cost, multilingual performance and arithmetic?
questions.followup: Why can the same sentence cost more tokens in Arabic than in English?

questions.q: What are the trade-offs of quantizing a model to 4 bits?
questions.followup: Why does quantization make local and edge deployment possible?

questions.q: What is Mixture of Experts, and why does it make large models cheaper to run?
questions.followup: Why do MoE models still need a lot of memory?

questions.q: Walk me through fine-tuning an open-weight model with LoRA.
questions.followup: Why does LoRA need far less GPU memory than full fine-tuning?

questions.q: How do you build and clean a fine-tuning dataset?
questions.followup: Why does data quality matter more than data quantity here?

questions.q: Compare RLHF and DPO.
questions.followup: Why has DPO become popular for smaller teams?

questions.q: What is catastrophic forgetting, and how do you prevent it?
questions.followup: Why should you test general skills after fine-tuning, not only the target task?

questions.q: How do you decide whether fine-tuning actually improved the model?
questions.followup: Why do you need a held-out evaluation set before you start?

questions.q: Design an AI agent that books meetings using a calendar API. What can go wrong?
questions.followup: Why must risky actions require human confirmation?

questions.q: How do you decide when an agent should stop?
questions.followup: Why are step limits and budgets needed even with a smart model?

questions.q: When is a simple workflow better than an autonomous agent?
questions.followup: Why do many production systems start as fixed workflows?

questions.q: How would you defend an agent against prompt injection from web pages or emails?
questions.followup: Why is it dangerous to let retrieved content give instructions?

questions.q: Explain MCP and how it differs from writing custom tool integrations.
questions.followup: Why does a shared protocol help an AI tools ecosystem?

questions.q: How do you design tool descriptions and schemas so the model calls tools correctly?
questions.followup: Why are clear tool names and error messages part of prompt design?

questions.q: How would you debug an agent that loops or repeats the same tool call?
questions.followup: Why is tracing every step essential for agents?

questions.q: Single agent or multi-agent: how do you choose?
questions.followup: Why does adding more agents often add cost and failure points?

questions.q: How do you give an agent memory across sessions?
questions.followup: Why is deciding what to forget as important as what to remember?

questions.q: How would you build an eval set for a new LLM feature?
questions.followup: Why should real user failures feed back into the eval set?

questions.q: What is LLM-as-a-judge, and what are its biases?
questions.followup: Why should you check the judge against human ratings?

questions.q: How do you run A/B tests for an LLM feature in production?
questions.followup: Why are offline evals not enough on their own?

questions.q: How do you detect regressions when you switch to a new model version?
questions.followup: Why can a "better" model still break your product?

questions.q: Which public benchmarks do you trust, and what are their limits?
questions.followup: Why is benchmark contamination a growing problem?

questions.q: Design a customer-support chatbot for a bank.
questions.followup: Why do regulated industries need extra guardrails and audit logs?

questions.q: Design an enterprise search assistant for 100,000 employees.
questions.followup: Why do caching and access control dominate the design at that scale?

questions.q: How do you reduce LLM cost without hurting quality?
questions.followup: Why is routing easy requests to a smaller model so effective?

questions.q: How do you reduce latency for a chat application?
questions.followup: Why does streaming improve how fast the app feels?

questions.q: What do you monitor for an LLM application in production?
questions.followup: Why do you need to log prompts and outputs, and how do you protect PII in them?

questions.q: How do you size GPUs for serving a 70B-parameter model?
questions.followup: Why does memory, not compute, usually decide the GPU count?

questions.q: How would you handle PII and sensitive data in prompts?
questions.followup: Why is redaction before the model call safer than after?

questions.q: How do you handle rate limits and outages from an LLM provider?
questions.followup: Why is a fallback model part of a reliable design?

questions.q: Explain the bias-variance trade-off with an example.
questions.followup: Why does more data usually help high-variance models?

questions.q: What is the vanishing gradient problem, and how is it solved?
questions.followup: Why did residual connections make very deep networks trainable?

questions.q: Compare batch normalization and layer normalization.
questions.followup: Why do transformers use layer normalization?

questions.q: How do you handle an imbalanced dataset?
questions.followup: Why can accuracy be a misleading metric here?

questions.q: Precision vs recall: when would you prefer each?
questions.followup: Why does a fraud detector usually favour recall?

questions.q: Design a recommendation system for an online store.
questions.followup: Why is the cold-start problem hard, and how do you handle it?

questions.q: How do you decide whether a problem actually needs AI?
questions.followup: Why can a simple rule beat a model?

questions.q: How would you measure the success of an AI feature after launch?
questions.followup: Why are business metrics and model metrics both needed?

questions.q: Build, buy, or use an API: how do you decide for an AI capability?
questions.followup: Why does the answer change as the product scales?

questions.q: How would you run a responsible-AI review before launch?
questions.followup: Why is "we will be careful about bias" not a real plan?

questions.q: An AI hiring tool shows bias against a group. What do you do?
questions.followup: Why is pausing the feature sometimes the right call?

questions.q: How do you design the user experience around model mistakes?
questions.followup: Why should users be able to see sources and correct the AI?

questions.q: How do you explain AI risks and limits to executives?
questions.followup: Why do clear limits build more trust than big promises?

questions.q: What AI regulations should a product team know about (for example the EU AI Act)?
questions.followup: Why does the risk level of a use case change your obligations?

questions.q: Tell me about an AI project that failed. What did you learn?
questions.followup: Why do interviewers value honest failure stories?

questions.q: Tell me about a time you shipped an AI feature under uncertainty.
questions.followup: Why is managing uncertainty a core skill for AI roles?

questions.q: How do you keep up with fast-moving AI research and tools?
questions.followup: Why is filtering the hype as important as reading the news?

questions.q: Describe a time you disagreed with a technical decision about AI.
questions.followup: Why do data and quick experiments resolve such disagreements best?
